story.title: The Sahara's Fastest Waddling Hunter
story.signature_move: It waddles upright at surprising speed before belly-sliding across the hot sand to ambush the startled fox.
story.hybrid_look: This imaginary predator has an upright bowling-pin body and flipper wings covered in dense waterproof feathers mixed with fur, a cheetah-shaped head with a penguin's mouth and eyes, short webbed feet, and a long ringed tail, moving with a side-to-side waddle.
